text:
Alex: Heads-up: after staging NCCL/driver/kernel roll last night some A100 nodes in us-west-2 are falling back to NET and losing NVLink P2P. Jobs are ~3x slower. Seeing SHM disabled in logs.

Priya: saw a couple reports — which build/driver got pushed?

Alex: rolled NCCL 2.18 + NVIDIA driver 545.29 + kernel 6.1.14 on the mixed fleet (A100/H100). Staging only but enough running distributed tests to notice.

Jamie: can you paste the NCCL log snippet and nvidia-smi topo output from an affected node?

Alex: pasted below (from one A100 node):
```
NCCL INFO Channel 0 : Using network (Socket) for inter-node comms, P2P disabled between GPU0 and GPU1
NCCL WARN: SHM disabled due to cudaIpcOpenMemHandle error - fallback to NET
NCCL INFO : P2P Level: NET/SOCKET (fallback)
```

Alex: and nvidia-smi topo -m:
```
        GPU0    GPU1    GPU2    GPU3    CPU    P2P
GPU0     X      SYS     SYS     SYS    NODE   SYS
GPU1    SYS      X      SYS     SYS    NODE   SYS
GPU2    SYS     SYS      X      SYS    NODE   SYS
GPU3    SYS     SYS     SYS      X     NODE   SYS
```

Priya: hmm that shows NVLink not being detected at all (should show NVLINK between some GPUs on A100). Are these the nodes that recently had a kernel patch?

Alex: yes, same nodes got the kernel + driver update via the new image. Non-upgraded nodes show proper NVLINK topo and no SHM warnings.

Jamie: this smells like a driver/kernel compatibility regression (NVLink probe failing). I vaguely remember a kernel 6.1.x change that impacted NVLINK behavior with 545 drivers.

OpsOnCall: tagging incident-1234 and notifying infra-oncall. Logs copied to /incidents/1234/nccl-nvlink.

SRE-Bot: incident-1234 created (sev2). Pager duty alerted.

Priya: can we repro on a single node with nccl-tests? run osu_allreduce or allreduce from nccl-tests on 4 GPUs and check NCCL_P2P/SHM messages.

Alex: running nccl-tests now on affected node — reproduction consistent: immediate NET fallback, 3-4x latency.

Jamie: temporary workaround: pin the node image to driver 535 or revert the kernel to previous kernel-5.x image on a canary subset. That should restore NVLink probe until we get a vendor fix.

Priya: alternative short-term env workaround: force SHM path by setting NCCL_SHM_DISABLE=0? but log says SHM errors are from cudaIpcOpenMemHandle, so SHM likely won't work. We could also force NCCL to prefer P2P with NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL? not sure that will help if NVLink isn't detected.

Jamie: true — env hacks won't resurrect NVLink if it's not visible at the kernel/driver level. Rollback is safest.

Alex: did a quick rollback on a canary node to driver 535 + kernel 5.15 image, rebooted, and nvidia-smi topo now shows NVLINK again. NCCL logs show SHM/IPC working and P2P using NVLINK.

Priya: good. what's next for the rest of the fleet? full rollback or hold patch until vendor provides a fix?

Jamie: propose: 1) pause further rollout; 2) re-image affected nodes back to 535/5.15 on the shard where many jobs run; 3) add automated topo preflight (nvidia-smi topo -m + quick nccl-test) to our image rollout pipeline; 4) open a bug with NVIDIA with logs and kernel version.

Alex: agree. I'll start bulk re-imaging of the affected us-west-2 pool to the 535 image and mark the current image as unreleased.

OpsOnCall: started reimage job (batch job id 9876). ETA ~45m for first 50 nodes.

SRE-Bot: reimage job 9876 started, progress updates every 10m.

Priya: also let's add a CI gate: when we promote a new driver/image, run a mixed-node NVLINK detection test and an allreduce across node-local GPUs. If that fails, fail promotion.

Jamie: I'll add the preflight to the image pipeline today. Also will prepare a short runbook for future NVLINK regressions (how to check topo, quick env vars to collect, action matrix: rollback vs hold).

Alex: filed bug with NVIDIA (case 2026-0422) with attached logs and topo outputs.

Priya: rough cost impact? jobs slowed 3x on affected pool — estimates show compute overrun + queued retries ~ $12k/day if not mitigated. Good we caught early in staging.

Alex: noted. after rollback observed perf back to baseline, will close incident when reimage completes.

OpsOnCall: reimage progress: 20/50 nodes done, NVLINK restored on those.

Jamie: follow-up items: (1) add nvidia-smi topo + nccl smoke to image CI, (2) add telemetry alert on "NCCL.*NET/SOCKET" warnings in logs, (3) pin stable driver in production catalog. I'll PR docs/runbook.

Priya: thanks everyone. keep updates here.

Alex: will post postmortem and action items once incident is closed. :thumbsup:
